answer: My answer to sybils is Proof of unique union membership dues record — dues paid monthly to one local for seven years — which makes the atlas of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Honest agents already carry what Proof of unique union membership dues record asks for, so they pass without noticing; the ferrous is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the tide of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
